# Ten-pass consistency and coherence review

Reviewed November 18, 2026, starting at `3f894f73885dff5ccdc242e1a453cb492f21789d`, for the [request to perform ten passes](https://phylaxsystems.slack.com/archives/C06T1DLBHGR/p1794880767080659). Applied the repository's [Diátaxis instructions](../../AGENTS.md).

These are ten distinct review lenses, with rereads after corrections, not ten claims to have independently certified every technical statement on every page. The full inventory and navigation establish coverage of the information architecture; detailed reading follows the learner, author, reviewer, operator, and infrastructure journeys. Runtime behavior and historical incident facts were not newly audited.

## Resulting ownership and journeys

- **Explanation** owns why local rollback, builder exclusion, guard reverts, Alerting and backtesting differ. **How-to** pages own local setup, troubleshooting, release changes and investigation.
- **Tutorials** retain bounded local exercises. **References** describe parameters, behavior, limits, and evidence without promising an unprovided procedure.
- An author moves from policy intent and exceptions to implementation, matching-trigger tests, a pending release, review, signing, activation, and verification for the selected environment.
- A maintainer selects the complete replacement set for an environment, follows the same review/authorization owner, and checks the delayed effect. A platform login does not confer Protocol Manager authority.
- An operator first establishes the result's mode, then diagnoses the assertion failure and records its disposition. Alert-only or simulated rejection is not live prevention.
- Ethereum and sequencer plans share validation concepts while retaining separate routing, guard, transaction-source and inclusion boundaries.
- Example status, API specification, assignment lifecycle, and evidence answer different questions. An integration design, compiled template, or pending release is not a production-readiness result.

- Mintlify links pass with `--check-anchors --check-snippets`; media-alt checks pass. Existing color contrast warning remains (primary/light meets AA at 4.83:1, not AAA).
- Inventory regeneration: 116 pages, 115 sidebar entries, 40 navigation nodes, 63 glossary terms, 25 snippets and 16 redirects. No route or redirect removed; all four renamed/removed section headings retain compatibility anchors.
- All 19 case-study risk labels match their navigation hub. This checks taxonomy, not fresh historical evidence.
- `git diff --check` passes. No assertion implementation, executable fixture, dependency pin, platform action or contract changed; a Solidity comment was clarified and duplicated illustrative blocks were removed from the explanation.
- Local Mintlify validation cannot download its client (`requires an internet connection`). Current rendered desktop/mobile layouts and diagram rendering remain unverified; earlier screenshots do not validate these edits. Hosted results for the pushed revision are recorded in the PR review.
- F25 remains open for authenticated platform labels/screenshots, deployment-specific permissions/guards, target-runtime compatibility and live enforcement. Source corrections do not close it.
- Previous example results retain their original scope; the illustrative PhyLock fuzz fragment is not a newly passing fixture. No additional Solidity execution or historical replay is claimed by this source review.
- Linear association remains pending after the owning live search returned HTTP 401; no ticket is inferred.

## Maintenance check for future changes

For a changed concept, compare its glossary definition, overview, task procedure, diagram, catalog label and linked destination. Check the reader's prerequisites, acting authority, environment, observation boundary, expected result and next action. Preserve old routes/anchors and record separately what was source-reviewed, executed, built, rendered or verified live. These cross-page checks address the recurring drift exposed by this review; a passing link check alone cannot establish semantic coherence.
